title: Honesty and Transparency (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to practise honesty and transparency in ways that build trust, safety, and emotional stability for children and partners.
learningOutcomes: Understand honesty in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise how secrecy harms family trust.
Develop habits that support accountability and safety.

modules.title: Honesty in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how openness supports children’s emotional security.

modules.title: Practising Transparency
modules.content: Provides tools for open, accountable communication.
